recurring_harms: injury from late escalation;discrimination against groups the system serves worst;fabricated content entering a record of authority
human_in_loop_decisions: Escalating a declining patient rejecting a candidate and handing control back to a driver all need a reviewer with time information and authority to overrule
strongest_guardrails: Local validation before trusting vendor metrics;a fallback that stays authoritative;a hard stop threshold with a named owner;logging every override
cross_industry_pattern: Across all three industries the reported harm landed on people who never chose the system, and the deciding factor was not model accuracy but whether the surrounding workflow kept an independent path to the same decision when the model was silent or wrong
